trace_adequacy.selection_rule: all 100 evaluation cases; first two usable train samples and four full hidden samples as declared; every changed scalar set is supplementary exploratory
missing_stages: full per-step task gradients and Adam moments
complete semantic inputs for other 432 usable train cases
trace_adequacy.target_boundary: Weak answer containment only in training; fixed evaluation Silver opened posthoc; decay-only arithmetic has no target or data input.

intervention_execution.claim: Semantic modules ran but both final heads produce zero residuals and exactly baseline score vectors for all 100 cases; the intended learned ranking intervention is absent.

intended_intermediate.claim: Projection/readout magnitudes collapse; question-conditioned encodings vary at only about 1e-31. Initial semantic inputs and projection outputs had nonzero variance.

observable_output.claim: Reader/quantum semantic/classical semantic positive/direct/membership totals are 203/138/355 each. Scalar control changes 16 sets but positive/direct remain 203/138, membership 348.

task_utility.claim: No downstream utility or generalization gain is demonstrated. Semantics cannot be compared as successfully trained mechanisms in this run.

primary_explanation.statement: Coupled Adam decay acts on all parameters while zero-scale anchoring suppresses initial gradients to projection/readout; recorded task gradients soon vanish and decay dominates, erasing semantic information. A label-free decay-only diagnostic nearly reproduces all three epoch projection norms and gate biases.
primary_explanation.confidence: high for observed collapse and decay compatibility; not a full replay of all task updates

alternative_explanations.statement: Noisy weak labels, insufficient positive/negative difficulty, small gate derivatives or early update interactions may contribute; only two training samples have full saved inputs, and optimizer states are absent.

The later committed mask compatibility fix matches the executed source hashes; its midpoint fallback is an unresolved production hardening concern, but all four captured samples have real SEP boundaries. It does not explain the observed parameter-collapse trajectory by itself.

discriminating_measurement.uncertainty: Training-health failure versus ineffective semantic features or weak supervision
discriminating_measurement.measurement: Before another task screen, qualify finite, nonzero data gradients after leaving exact-null initialization, parameter/encoding variance preservation and nonzero score corrections on outcome-blind train-only cases; compare optimizer groups and null-compatible learning path without Silver.
discriminating_measurement.primary_outcome: Head learns a demonstrably input-dependent correction on training-only probes with preserved features, permitting a separately approved task screen.
discriminating_measurement.alternative_outcome: Gate/readout still collapse or remain input-independent: stop before collaborator screen and revise the learning path.

forbidden_rescue_variants: Rerun this unchanged configuration with more epochs or more questions
Tune Silver coefficients or deepen the circuit to compensate for absent training
Call zero correction a negative result for semantic or quantum expressive capacity

positive_carryovers.mechanism: The disabled residual recovers the stable relevance baseline exactly.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: Retain exact-null behavior but verify a viable data-gradient path rather than permanent null output.

positive_carryovers.mechanism: Producer-side hashes, sampled states, checkpoints and full eval replay reveal collapse that final scores alone conceal.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: Reuse this registered artifact; keep raw arrays exchange-only and all-panel evaluation separate from examples.

recovery_outcome.stop_reason: Stop new method selection and broader/further collaborator task runs until the observed training-path defect is repaired and qualified. This is evidence repair, not closure of the semantic/quantum family. User authorization is still required for that repair and a new screen.

limitations: Single exposed 100-question Silver development panel and short weak-supervised budget; L0 only.
Decoupled decay and staged learning are repair hypotheses, not measured task improvements.
Previous Q-ARCG training provenance remains missing; this run does not reconstruct it.
